title: Asshur
summary: Son of Shem (Gen 10:22); KJV Gen 10:11 has "Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh".
description: Son of Shem (Gen 10:22); KJV Gen 10:11 has "Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh". Josephus (Antiquities I.6.4, Whiston): "Ashur lived at the city Nineve; and named his subjects Assyrians"

open_questions: Place link is by name: OpenBible identifies the place named in later scripture (Gen.10.11, Gen.10.12, Gen.2.14, Num.24.22, Num.24.24), not the Gen 10 ancestor. Certainty: nineveh very-high; rehoboth-ir medium (55%); calah very-high; assyria very-high; assur very-high.
